## TDD proof

- [ ] RED test written and demonstrated failing for the intended behavior
- [ ] GREEN feature implemented and tests actually executed
- [ ] REFACTOR no regression; package lock/versioning, docs + ADR updated
- [ ] API/DB integration xUnit real where relevant
- [ ] Playwright browser / device smoke where relevant
- [ ] Provider parity, threat model and tenant isolation tests when data involved

## Privacy / safety

- [ ] Input untrusted and connector/MCP permissions reviewed
- [ ] Consent and revocation enforced; no unauthorized recording/actions
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in logs/files
- [ ] Feature limitation/unsupported platform paths documented
